basic_info.description: Welcome to your fantasy skybox; an elegant 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the esteemed SOMA Grand, a full-service building that redefines City living. This popular corner offers sweeping City and Bay views and invites you into a world of luxury and comfort.  Desirable open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living spaces while offering sweeping views from every room. The spacious kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with stainless steel appliances, Studio Becker cabinets, and cambra-quartz countertops, ensuring both functionality and style. Bathed in natural light, the ambiance is airy and welcoming. Retreat to the tranquil primary suite with a large walk-in closet or the second bedroom with great views for rest and recovery. The convenience of a rare, assigned parking space adds to the seamless living experience.  Living in the SOMA Grand means embracing a lifestyle of unparalleled amenities and services. In addition to 24-hour security and daily concierge service, enjoy the luxury of housekeeping, indulge in the simple pleasure of coffee and tea service in the lobby, and stay active and rejuvenated with access to the gym and spa. The park level, complete with BBQ facilities and a community room, offers a perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing in the great outdoors.
